answer: One concrete defense is a vouching bond: a new agent can join only if an established agent locks stake behind it, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster. Like a signature made with a quill in ink, the vouch is permanent and traceable. It is not a velvet rope of reputation alone but real cost, so a sybil swarm runs onto a reef of forfeited bonds, since every fake identity needs a separate voucher willing to lose money.
